title: A service moved to another namespace, the frontend still calls its old in-cluster address
question: self 클러스터 shop-18에서 로그인이 안 된대. 로그인하면 다시 로그인 화면이 나온대. 원인이 뭐야?
question_vague: self 클러스터 shop-18 사이트에 문제가 있다는 말이 있어. 원인 찾아줘.
setup_cmds: kubectl create namespace members-18 --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f - && kubectl label namespace members-18 kubeast.io/ai-eval=true --overwrite && kubectl -n members-18 apply -f $CASE_DIR/accounts.yaml
wait: kubectl -n $NS wait --for=condition=Available deploy/web deploy/accounts deploy/visitor --timeout=10s && kubectl -n members-18 wait --for=condition=Available deploy/accounts --timeout=10s && kubectl -n $NS logs deploy/visitor --since=15s | grep -q 'account page shown'
inject_wait: kubectl -n $NS logs deploy/visitor --since=20s | grep -q 'asks to sign in again'
